name: Good interpersonal relationships are important for both our study and our future career.
trans: 良好的人际关系对我们的学习和未来职业都很重要。

name: We should get along well with others and build mutual trust in daily life.
trans: 我们应该在日常生活中与他人和睦相处并建立相互信任。

name: Effective communication is the key to avoiding misunderstanding and resolving conflicts.
trans: 有效沟通是避免误解和解决冲突的关键。

name: When we disagree with others, we should handle disagreements calmly instead of losing our temper.
trans: 当我们与他人意见不合时，应冷静处理分歧，而不是发脾气。

name: Putting oneself in others’ shoes helps us understand their feelings and promote mutual understanding.
trans: 设身处地为他人着想有助于我们理解他们的感受并增进相互理解。

name: Listening patiently is an important part of interpersonal communication.
trans: 耐心倾听是人际沟通的重要组成部分。

name: Cooperation with others can help us develop team spirit and improve our social skills.
trans: 与他人合作可以帮助我们培养团队精神并提高社交技能。

name: Honesty and sincerity are the foundation of lasting friendship.
trans: 诚实和真诚是长久友谊的基础。

name: We should respect differences and be open-minded and tolerant when communicating with others.
trans: 与他人交往时，我们应尊重差异、开放包容。

name: A smile and proper body language can help us leave a good impression on others.
trans: 微笑和恰当的肢体语言能帮助我们给他人留下好印象。

name: When our friends are in trouble, we should offer emotional support and encourage them.
trans: 当朋友遇到困难时，我们应提供情感支持并鼓励他们。

name: Only by communicating sincerely can we build harmonious relationships with others.
trans: 只有真诚沟通，我们才能与他人建立和谐关系。

name: It is widely acknowledged that good interpersonal relationships are essential to personal development.
trans: 众所周知，良好的人际关系对个人发展至关重要。

name: There is no denying that effective communication helps avoid misunderstanding and conflict.
trans: 不可否认，有效沟通有助于避免误解和冲突。

name: As college students, we should learn to respect others and communicate effectively.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该学会尊重他人并进行有效沟通。

name: Only by putting ourselves in others’ shoes can we truly understand them.
trans: 只有设身处地为他人着想，我们才能真正理解他们。

name: While differences are natural, we should respect them and seek common ground.
trans: 虽然差异是自然的，但我们应尊重差异、寻求共识。

name: Building good interpersonal relationships enables us to gain trust, support and friendship.
trans: 建立良好人际关系使我们能够获得信任、支持和友谊。
